posts.zh:
dsh-unsloth-hands 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地运行的 Unsloth Desktop（Unsloth Studio）服务器：unsloth_run 与 unsloth_vision 两个工具，纯 HTTP 客户端，不拉起也不持有任何进程。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3259c4d8db2f5bd3a14b.html
posts.en:
dsh-unsloth-hands is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a locally running Unsloth Desktop (Unsloth Studio) server through unsloth_run and unsloth_vision tools; pure HTTP client, never spawns or owns processes.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3259c4d8db2f5bd3a14b.html
